   552→// classifyToolType maps Codex tool names to standard tool types
   553→func classifyToolType(toolName string) string {
   554→	switch toolName {
   555→	case "shell", "shell_command", "exec_command": // `shell` is legacy
   556→		return "shell"
   557→	case "update_plan":
   558→		return "task"
   559→	case "view_image":
   560→		return "read"
   561→	case "apply_patch":
   562→		return "write"
   563→	case "list_mcp_resources", "list_mcp_resource_templates", "read_mcp_resource":
   564→		return "generic"
   565→	default:
   566→		return "unknown"
   567→	}
   568→}
   569→
   570→// extractPathHints extracts file paths from tool inputs.
   571→// For apply_patch: parses patch format for file paths.
   572→// For other tools: checks common path fields like "path", "file", etc.
   573→func extractPathHints(toolName string, input map[string]interface{}, inputText string, workspaceRoot string) []string {
   574→	var paths []string
   575→
   576→	if toolName == "apply_patch" {
   577→		// Parse patch format to extract file paths
   578→		// Look for lines like "*** Modify File: path", "*** Create File: path", "*** Delete File: path"
   579→		if inputText != "" {
   580→			paths = extractPathsFromPatch(inputText, workspaceRoot)
   581→		} else if inputStr, ok := input["input"].(string); ok {
   582→			paths = extractPathsFromPatch(inputStr, workspaceRoot)
   583→		}
   584→	} else {
   585→		// For other tools, check common path fields
   586→		pathFields := []string{"path", "file", "filename", "file_path"}
   587→		for _, field := range pathFields {
   588→			if value, ok := input[field].(string); ok && value != "" {
   589→				normalizedPath := spi.NormalizePath(value, workspaceRoot)
   590→				if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
   591→					paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
   592→				}
   593→			}
   594→		}
   595→
   596→		// Extract paths from shell commands (redirect targets, file-creating commands)
   597→		// exec_command uses "cmd", shell_command uses "command"
   598→		command, _ := input["command"].(string)
   599→		if command == "" {
   600→			command, _ = input["cmd"].(string)
   601→		}
   602→		if command != "" {
   603→			cwd, _ := input["workdir"].(string)
   604→			if cwd == "" {
   605→				cwd = workspaceRoot
   606→			}
   607→			shellPaths := spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, cwd, workspaceRoot)
   608→			for _, sp := range shellPaths {
   609→				if !contains(paths, sp) {
   610→					paths = append(paths, sp)
   611→				}
   612→			}
   613→		}
   614→	}
   615→
   616→	return paths
   617→}
   618→
   619→// extractPathsFromPatch parses apply_patch input to find file paths
   620→func extractPathsFromPatch(patchText string, workspaceRoot string) []string {
   621→	var paths []string
   622→	lines := strings.Split(patchText, "\n")
   623→
   624→	for _, line := range lines {
   625→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   626→
   627→		// Look for patch markers - both "Create File" and "Add File" are valid
   628→		markers := []string{
   629→			"*** Modify File:",
   630→			"*** Update File:",
   631→			"*** Create File:",
   632→			"*** Add File:",
   633→			"*** Delete File:",
   634→			"*** Rename File:",
   635→			"*** Remove File:",
   636→		}
   637→
   638→		for _, marker := range markers {
   639→			if strings.HasPrefix(line, marker) {
   640→				path := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, marker))
   641→				if path != "" {
   642→					normalizedPath := spi.NormalizePath(path, workspaceRoot)
   643→					if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
   644→						paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
   645→					}
   646→				}
   647→				break
   648→			}
   649→		}
   650→
   651→		// For rename, also check for "*** New Name:" marker
   652→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*** New Name:") {
   653→			path := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "*** New Name:"))
   654→			if path != "" {
   655→				normalizedPath := spi.NormalizePath(path, workspaceRoot)
   656→				if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
   657→					paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
   658→				}
   659→			}
   660→		}
   661→	}
   662→
   663→	return paths
   664→}
   665→
   666→// contains checks if a string slice contains a value
   667→func contains(slice []string, value string) bool {
   668→	for _, item := range slice {
   669→		if item == value {
   670→			return true
   671→		}
   672→	}
   673→	return false
   674→}
   675→
   676→// extractUsageFromTokenCount extracts token usage from a token_count event's info.last_token_usage
   677→// Codex CLI emits token_count events with the structure:
   678→//
   679→//	{
   680→//	  "type": "event_msg",
   681→//	  "payload": {
   682→//	    "type": "token_count",
   683→//	    "info": {
   684→//	      "last_token_usage": { "input_tokens": N, "cached_input_tokens": N, "output_tokens": N, "reasoning_output_tokens": N, ... },
   685→//	      "total_token_usage": { ... }
   686→//	    }
   687→//	  }
   688→//	}
   689→//
   690→// We use last_token_usage for per-turn usage (total_token_usage is cumulative).
   691→// Codex CLI uses its own token field names, stored in the Codex-specific fields of Usage.
   692→func extractUsageFromTokenCount(payload map[string]interface{}) *Usage {
   693→	info, ok := payload["info"].(map[string]interface{})
   694→	if !ok {
   695→		return nil
   696→	}
   697→
   698→	// Use last_token_usage for per-turn metrics (not cumulative)
   699→	lastUsage, ok := info["last_token_usage"].(map[string]interface{})
   700→	if !ok {
   701→		return nil
   702→	}
   703→
   704→	return &Usage{
   705→		// Common fields
   706→		InputTokens:  schema.GetIntFromMap(lastUsage, "input_tokens"),
   707→		OutputTokens: schema.GetIntFromMap(lastUsage, "output_tokens"),
   708→		// Codex CLI specific fields
   709→		CachedInputTokens:     schema.GetIntFromMap(lastUsage, "cached_input_tokens"),
   710→		ReasoningOutputTokens: schema.GetIntFromMap(lastUsage, "reasoning_output_tokens"),
   711→	}
   712→}

    11→	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi/schema"
    12→)
    13→
    14→// Type aliases for convenience - use the shared schema types
    15→type (
    16→	SessionData  = schema.SessionData
    17→	ProviderInfo = schema.ProviderInfo
    18→	Exchange     = schema.Exchange
    19→	Message      = schema.Message
    20→	ContentPart  = schema.ContentPart
    21→	ToolInfo     = schema.ToolInfo
    22→	Usage        = schema.Usage
    23→)
    24→
    25→// convertTokensToUsage converts Gemini's token structure to the shared Usage type.
    26→// Returns nil if tokens is nil.
    27→func convertTokensToUsage(tokens *GeminiTokens) *Usage {
    28→	if tokens == nil {
    29→		return nil
    30→	}
    31→	return &Usage{
    32→		InputTokens:   tokens.Input,
    33→		OutputTokens:  tokens.Output,
    34→		CachedTokens:  tokens.Cached,
    35→		ThoughtTokens: tokens.Thoughts,
    36→		ToolTokens:    tokens.Tool,
    37→	}
    38→}
    39→
    40→// GenerateAgentSession creates a SessionData from a GeminiSession
    41→// The session should already be parsed and normalized (messages sorted, warmup trimmed)
    42→func GenerateAgentSession(session *GeminiSession, workspaceRoot string) (*SessionData, error) {
    43→	slog.Info("GenerateAgentSession: Starting", "sessionID", session.ID, "messageCount", len(session.Messages))
    44→
    45→	if len(session.Messages) == 0 {
    46→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("session has no messages")
    47→	}
    48→
    49→	// Use session's start time as createdAt
    50→	createdAt := session.StartTime
    51→	if createdAt == "" {
    52→		createdAt = session.LastUpdated
    53→	}
    54→
    55→	// Build exchanges from messages
    56→	exchanges, err := buildExchangesFromMessages(session.Messages, workspaceRoot)
    57→	if err != nil {
    58→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build exchanges: %w", err)
    59→	}
    60→
    61→	// Assign exchangeId to each exchange (format: sessionId:index)
    62→	for i := range exchanges {
    63→		exchanges[i].ExchangeID = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.ID, i)
    64→	}
    65→
    66→	slog.Info("GenerateAgentSession: Built exchanges", "count", len(exchanges))
    67→
    68→	// Populate FormattedMarkdown for all tools
    69→	for i := range exchanges {
    70→		for j := range exchanges[i].Messages {
    71→			msg := &exchanges[i].Messages[j]
    72→			if msg.Tool != nil {
    73→				formattedMd := formatToolAsMarkdown(msg.Tool)
    74→				msg.Tool.FormattedMarkdown = &formattedMd
    75→			}
    76→		}
    77→	}
    78→
    79→	sessionData := &SessionData{
    80→		SchemaVersion: "1.0",
    81→		Provider: ProviderInfo{
    82→			ID:      "gemini-cli",
    83→			Name:    "Gemini CLI",
    84→			Version: "unknown",
    85→		},
    86→		SessionID:     session.ID,
    87→		CreatedAt:     createdAt,
    88→		WorkspaceRoot: workspaceRoot,
    89→		Exchanges:     exchanges,
    90→	}
    91→
    92→	return sessionData, nil
    93→}
    94→
    95→// buildExchangesFromMessages groups GeminiMessages into exchanges
    96→// An exchange starts with a user message and includes all subsequent agent messages until the next user message
    97→func buildExchangesFromMessages(messages []GeminiMessage, workspaceRoot string) ([]Exchange, error) {
    98→	var exchanges []Exchange
    99→	var currentExchange *Exchange
   100→
   101→	for _, msg := range messages {
   102→		switch msg.Type {
   103→		case "user":
   104→			// Start a new exchange
   105→			if currentExchange != nil && len(currentExchange.Messages) > 0 {
   106→				exchanges = append(exchanges, *currentExchange)
   107→			}
   108→
   109→			currentExchange = &Exchange{
   110→				StartTime: msg.Timestamp,
   111→				Messages:  []Message{},
   112→			}
   113→
   114→			// Build user message and handle referenced files extraction
   115→			userMsg, refMsgs := buildUserMessageWithReferences(msg)
   116→			currentExchange.Messages = append(currentExchange.Messages, userMsg)
   117→
   118→			// Add synthetic agent messages for referenced files
   119→			currentExchange.Messages = append(currentExchange.Messages, refMsgs...)
   120→
   121→		case "gemini":
   122→			// Agent message - add to current exchange
   123→			if currentExchange == nil {
   124→				// Create exchange if we don't have one (shouldn't happen normally)
   125→				currentExchange = &Exchange{
   126→					StartTime: msg.Timestamp,
   127→					Messages:  []Message{},
   128→				}
   129→			}
   130→
   131→			// Add messages for agent response (may produce multiple messages for tool calls)
   132→			agentMsgs := buildAgentMessages(msg, workspaceRoot)
   133→			currentExchange.Messages = append(currentExchange.Messages, agentMsgs...)
   134→			currentExchange.EndTime = msg.Timestamp
   135→		}
   136→	}
   137→
   138→	// Add the last exchange if exists
   139→	if currentExchange != nil && len(currentExchange.Messages) > 0 {
   140→		exchanges = append(exchanges, *currentExchange)
   141→	}
   142→
   143→	return exchanges, nil
   144→}
   145→
   146→// buildUserMessageWithReferences creates a user Message and extracts referenced file content
   147→// Returns the user message and any synthetic agent messages for referenced files
   148→func buildUserMessageWithReferences(msg GeminiMessage) (Message, []Message) {
   149→	content := strings.TrimSpace(msgContent(msg))
   150→
   151→	// Extract referenced file sections from user message
   152→	mainContent, refSections := extractReferencedSections(content)
   153→
   154→	var contentParts []ContentPart
   155→	if mainContent != "" {
   156→		contentParts = append(contentParts, ContentPart{
   157→			Type: "text",
   158→			Text: mainContent,
   159→		})
   160→	}
   161→
   162→	userMsg := Message{
   163→		ID:        msg.ID,
   164→		Timestamp: msg.Timestamp,
   165→		Role:      "user",
   166→		Content:   contentParts,
   167→	}
   168→
   169→	// Build synthetic agent messages for each referenced file section
   170→	var refMsgs []Message
   171→	for _, refContent := range refSections {
   172→		refMsg := buildReferencedFilesMessage(refContent, msg.Timestamp)
   173→		refMsgs = append(refMsgs, refMsg)
   174→	}
   175→
   176→	return userMsg, refMsgs
   177→}
   178→
   179→// buildReferencedFilesMessage creates a synthetic agent message for referenced file content
   180→func buildReferencedFilesMessage(content string, timestamp string) Message {
   181→	// Format the content with HTML escaping
   182→	formattedContent := formatReferencedFilesMarkdown(content)
   183→
   184→	tool := &ToolInfo{
   185→		Name:  "referenced_files",
   186→		Type:  "read",
   187→		UseID: fmt.Sprintf("ref_%s", timestamp),
   188→		Input: map[string]interface{}{
   189→			"content": content,
   190→		},
   191→		FormattedMarkdown: &formattedContent,
   192→	}
   193→
   194→	return Message{
   195→		Timestamp: timestamp,
   196→		Role:      "agent",
   197→		Tool:      tool,
   198→	}
   199→}
   200→
   201→// formatReferencedFilesMarkdown formats referenced file content for markdown display
   202→func formatReferencedFilesMarkdown(content string) string {
   203→	if content == "" {
   204→		return ""
   205→	}
   206→	return fmt.Sprintf("\n\n<pre><code>%s</code></pre>\n", html.EscapeString(content))
   207→}
   208→
   209→// buildAgentMessages creates Messages from a Gemini agent message
   210→// Returns multiple messages: one for thoughts, one per tool call, and one for text content
   211→// Token usage is attached to the last message only to avoid double-counting in aggregation
   212→func buildAgentMessages(msg GeminiMessage, workspaceRoot string) []Message {
   213→	var messages []Message
   214→	usage := convertTokensToUsage(msg.Tokens)
   215→
   216→	// Add thinking content from Thoughts
   217→	if len(msg.Thoughts) > 0 {
   218→		thinkingMsg := buildThinkingMessage(msg)
   219→		messages = append(messages, thinkingMsg)
   220→	}
   221→
   222→	// Add a message for each tool call
   223→	for _, toolCall := range msg.ToolCalls {
   224→		toolMsg := buildToolMessage(msg, toolCall, workspaceRoot)
   225→		messages = append(messages, toolMsg)
   226→	}
   227→
   228→	// Add text content message if present
   229→	textContent := strings.TrimSpace(msgContent(msg))
   230→	if textContent != "" {
   231→		textMsg := Message{
   232→			ID:        msg.ID,
   233→			Timestamp: msg.Timestamp,
   234→			Role:      "agent",
   235→			Model:     msg.Model,
   236→			Content: []ContentPart{
   237→				{Type: "text", Text: textContent},
   238→			},
   239→		}
   240→		messages = append(messages, textMsg)
   241→	}
   242→
   243→	// Attach usage to the last message only to avoid double-counting in aggregation
   244→	if len(messages) > 0 && usage != nil {
   245→		messages[len(messages)-1].Usage = usage
   246→	}
   247→
   248→	return messages
   249→}
   250→
   251→// buildThinkingMessage creates a Message containing thinking content from GeminiThoughts
   252→func buildThinkingMessage(msg GeminiMessage) Message {
   253→	var thinkingText strings.Builder
   254→	for _, thought := range msg.Thoughts {
   255→		subject := strings.TrimSpace(thought.Subject)
   256→		if subject == "" {
   257→			subject = "Thought"
   258→		}
   259→		description := strings.TrimSpace(thought.Description)
   260→		if description == "" {
   261→			description = "(no description)"
   262→		}
   263→		fmt.Fprintf(&thinkingText, "- **%s** — %s\n", subject, description)
   264→	}
   265→
   266→	// Trim trailing newline to avoid double-newline when markdown adds closing tag
   267→	text := strings.TrimSuffix(thinkingText.String(), "\n")
   268→
   269→	return Message{
   270→		ID:        msg.ID,
   271→		Timestamp: msg.Timestamp,
   272→		Role:      "agent",
   273→		Model:     msg.Model,
   274→		Content: []ContentPart{
   275→			{Type: "thinking", Text: text},
   276→		},
   277→	}
   278→}
   279→
   280→// buildToolMessage creates a Message for a single tool call
   281→func buildToolMessage(msg GeminiMessage, toolCall GeminiToolCall, workspaceRoot string) Message {
   282→	// Convert GeminiToolCall to ToolInfo
   283→	toolInfo := convertToolCall(toolCall)
   284→
   285→	// Extract path hints from tool input
   286→	pathHints := extractPathHintsFromTool(toolCall, workspaceRoot)
   287→
   288→	return Message{
   289→		ID:        toolCall.ID,
   290→		Timestamp: toolCall.Timestamp,
   291→		Role:      "agent",
   292→		Model:     msg.Model,
   293→		Tool:      toolInfo,
   294→		PathHints: pathHints,
   295→	}
   296→}
   297→
   298→// convertToolCall converts a GeminiToolCall to a ToolInfo
   299→func convertToolCall(toolCall GeminiToolCall) *ToolInfo {
   300→	// Build output from tool results
   301→	var output map[string]interface{}
   302→	if len(toolCall.Result) > 0 && toolCall.Result[0].FunctionResponse != nil {
   303→		output = toolCall.Result[0].FunctionResponse.Response
   304→	}
   305→
   306→	// If no structured output, try ResultDisplay
   307→	if output == nil {
   308→		if display := resultDisplayString(toolCall.ResultDisplay); display != "" {
   309→			output = map[string]interface{}{
   310→				"output": display,
   311→			}
   312→		}
   313→	}
   314→
   315→	return &ToolInfo{
   316→		Name:   toolCall.Name,
   317→		Type:   classifyGeminiToolType(toolCall.Name),
   318→		UseID:  toolCall.ID,
   319→		Input:  toolCall.Args,
   320→		Output: output,
   321→	}
   322→}
   323→
   324→// classifyGeminiToolType maps Gemini tool names to standard tool types
   325→// Valid types: write, read, search, shell, task, generic, unknown
   326→func classifyGeminiToolType(toolName string) string {
   327→	switch toolName {
   328→	case "read_file", "read_many_files", "web_fetch":
   329→		return "read"
   330→	case "write_file", "replace", "smart_edit":
   331→		return "write"
   332→	case "run_shell_command", "list_directory":
   333→		return "shell"
   334→	case "search_file_content", "google_web_search", "glob":
   335→		return "search"
   336→	case "write_todos":
   337→		return "task"
   338→	case "save_memory", "codebase_investigator", "delegate_to_agent":
   339→		return "generic"
   340→	default:
   341→		return "unknown"
   342→	}
   343→}
   344→
   345→// extractPathHintsFromTool extracts file paths from Gemini tool call args
   346→func extractPathHintsFromTool(toolCall GeminiToolCall, workspaceRoot string) []string {
   347→	var paths []string
   348→
   349→	// Common path field names for Gemini tools
   350→	pathFields := []string{"file_path", "dir_path", "path"}
   351→
   352→	for _, field := range pathFields {
   353→		if value := inputAsString(toolCall.Args, field); value != "" {
   354→			normalizedPath := spi.NormalizePath(value, workspaceRoot)
   355→			if !slices.Contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
   356→				paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
   357→			}
   358→		}
   359→	}
   360→
   361→	// Extract paths from shell commands (redirect targets, file-creating commands)
   362→	if command := inputAsString(toolCall.Args, "command"); command != "" {
   363→		cwd := inputAsString(toolCall.Args, "dir_path")
   364→		if cwd == "" {
   365→			cwd = workspaceRoot
   366→		}
   367→		shellPaths := spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, cwd, workspaceRoot)
   368→		for _, sp := range shellPaths {
   369→			if !slices.Contains(paths, sp) {
   370→				paths = append(paths, sp)
   371→			}
   372→		}
   373→	}
   374→
   375→	return paths
   376→}
   377→
   378→// extractReferencedSections extracts "--- Content from referenced files ---" sections from a message
   379→// Returns the main content (without markers) and the extracted reference sections
   380→func extractReferencedSections(message string) (string, []string) {
   381→	const marker = "--- Content from referenced files ---"
   382→	var sections []string
   383→	remaining := message
   384→
   385→	for {
   386→		idx := strings.Index(remaining, marker)
   387→		if idx == -1 {
   388→			break
   389→		}
   390→		before := strings.TrimRight(remaining[:idx], "\n ")
   391→		after := remaining[idx+len(marker):]
   392→
   393→		next := strings.Index(after, marker)
   394→		var block string
   395→		if next == -1 {
   396→			block = strings.TrimSpace(after)
   397→			remaining = before
   398→		} else {
   399→			block = strings.TrimSpace(after[:next])
   400→			remaining = strings.TrimSpace(before + after[next:])
   401→		}
   402→
   403→		if block != "" {
   404→			sections = append(sections, block)
   405→		}
   406→	}
   407→
   408→	return strings.TrimSpace(remaining), sections
   409→}
   410→

    38→// GenerateAgentSession converts an fdSession into the shared SessionData schema.
    39→func GenerateAgentSession(session *fdSession, workspaceRoot string) (*SessionData, error) {
    40→	if session == nil {
    41→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("session is nil")
    42→	}
    43→
    44→	workspaceRoot = strings.TrimSpace(workspaceRoot)
    45→	if sessionRoot := strings.TrimSpace(session.WorkspaceRoot); sessionRoot != "" {
    46→		workspaceRoot = sessionRoot
    47→	}
    48→
    49→	exchanges, lastTimestamp := buildExchanges(session, workspaceRoot)
    50→	if len(exchanges) == 0 {
    51→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("session contains no conversational exchanges")
    52→	}
    53→
    54→	for idx := range exchanges {
    55→		exchanges[idx].ExchangeID = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.ID, idx)
    56→		ensureExchangeTimestamps(&exchanges[idx])
    57→	}
    58→
    59→	// Apply session-level token usage to the last message of the last exchange.
    60→	// Droid CLI provides aggregate token usage for the entire session, not per-message.
    61→	// Attaching to the last message ensures proper aggregation in telemetry.
    62→	if usage := convertTokenUsage(session.TokenUsage); usage != nil {
    63→		if lastExchange := &exchanges[len(exchanges)-1]; len(lastExchange.Messages) > 0 {
    64→			lastExchange.Messages[len(lastExchange.Messages)-1].Usage = usage
    65→		}
    66→	}
    67→
    68→	created := strings.TrimSpace(session.CreatedAt)
    69→	if created == "" {
    70→		created = exchanges[0].StartTime
    71→	}
    72→	if created == "" {
    73→		created = lastTimestamp
    74→	}
    75→
    76→	updated := strings.TrimSpace(lastTimestamp)
    77→	if updated == "" {
    78→		updated = created
    79→	}
    80→
    81→	data := &SessionData{
    82→		SchemaVersion: "1.0",

    84→			ID:      "droid-cli",
    85→			Name:    "Factory Droid CLI",
    86→			Version: "unknown",
    87→		},
    88→		SessionID:     session.ID,
    89→		CreatedAt:     created,
    90→		UpdatedAt:     updated,
    91→		Slug:          session.Slug,

    94→	}

    99→func buildExchanges(session *fdSession, workspaceRoot string) ([]Exchange, string) {
   100→	var exchanges []Exchange
   101→	var current *Exchange
   102→	var lastTimestamp string
   103→	lastBlockWasUser := false
   104→
   105→	flush := func() {
   106→		if current == nil {
   107→			return
   108→		}
   109→		if len(current.Messages) > 0 {
   110→			if current.StartTime == "" {
   111→				current.StartTime = current.Messages[0].Timestamp
   112→			}
   113→			if current.EndTime == "" {
   114→				current.EndTime = current.Messages[len(current.Messages)-1].Timestamp
   115→			}
   116→			exchanges = append(exchanges, *current)
   117→		}
   118→		current = nil
   119→		lastBlockWasUser = false
   120→	}
   121→
   122→	appendMessage := func(msg Message, timestamp string) {
   123→		if current == nil {
   124→			current = &Exchange{StartTime: timestamp}
   125→		}
   126→		current.Messages = append(current.Messages, msg)
   127→		if timestamp != "" {
   128→			current.EndTime = timestamp
   129→		}
   130→	}
   131→
   132→	for _, block := range session.Blocks {
   133→		ts := strings.TrimSpace(block.Timestamp)
   134→		if ts != "" {
   135→			lastTimestamp = ts
   136→		}
   137→
   138→		if isUserBlock(block) {
   139→			text := cleanUserText(block.Text)
   140→			if text == "" {
   141→				continue
   142→			}
   143→			if !lastBlockWasUser {
   144→				flush()
   145→				current = &Exchange{StartTime: ts}
   146→			}
   147→			msg := Message{
   148→				ID:        strings.TrimSpace(block.MessageID),
   149→				Timestamp: ts,
   150→				Role:      "user",
   151→				Content: []ContentPart{
   152→					{Type: "text", Text: text},
   153→				},
   154→			}
   155→			appendMessage(msg, ts)
   156→			lastBlockWasUser = true
   157→			continue
   158→		}
   159→
   160→		if current == nil {
   161→			current = &Exchange{StartTime: ts}
   162→		}
   163→		lastBlockWasUser = false
   164→
   165→		switch block.Kind {
   166→		case blockText:
   167→			if msg := buildAgentTextMessage(block); msg != nil {
   168→				appendMessage(*msg, ts)
   169→			}
   170→		case blockTool:
   171→			if msg := buildToolMessage(block, workspaceRoot); msg != nil {
   172→				appendMessage(*msg, ts)
   173→			}
   174→		case blockTodo:
   175→			if msg := buildTodoMessage(block); msg != nil {
   176→				appendMessage(*msg, ts)
   177→			}
   178→		case blockSummary:
   179→			if msg := buildSummaryMessage(block); msg != nil {
   180→				appendMessage(*msg, ts)
   181→			}
   182→		}
   183→	}
   184→
   185→	flush()
   186→	return exchanges, lastTimestamp
   187→}

   189→func ensureExchangeTimestamps(ex *Exchange) {
   190→	if ex.StartTime == "" && len(ex.Messages) > 0 {
   191→		ex.StartTime = ex.Messages[0].Timestamp
   192→	}
   193→	if ex.EndTime == "" && len(ex.Messages) > 0 {
   194→		ex.EndTime = ex.Messages[len(ex.Messages)-1].Timestamp
   195→	}
   196→}

   198→func isUserBlock(block fdBlock) bool {
   199→	return block.Kind == blockText && strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(block.Role), "user")

   299→func convertToolCallToInfo(call *fdToolCall) *ToolInfo {
   300→	if call == nil {
   301→		return nil
   302→	}
   303→	name := strings.TrimSpace(call.Name)
   304→	if name == "" {
   305→		name = "tool"
   306→	}
   307→	useID := strings.TrimSpace(call.ID)
   308→	if useID == "" {
   309→		useID = fmt.Sprintf("tool-%s", strings.ReplaceAll(call.InvokedAt, ":", ""))
   310→	}
   311→	args := decodeInput(call.Input)
   312→	var output map[string]interface{}
   313→	if call.Result != nil {
   314→		content := strings.TrimSpace(call.Result.Content)
   315→		if content != "" || call.Result.IsError {
   316→			output = map[string]interface{}{
   317→				"content": content,
   318→				"isError": call.Result.IsError,
   319→			}
   320→		}
   321→	}
   322→	tool := &ToolInfo{
   323→		Name:   name,
   324→		Type:   toolType(name),
   325→		UseID:  useID,
   326→		Input:  args,
   327→		Output: output,
   328→	}
   329→	if call.RiskLevel != "" {
   330→		summary := fmt.Sprintf("Risk level: %s", call.RiskLevel)
   331→		if strings.TrimSpace(call.RiskReason) != "" {
   332→			summary = fmt.Sprintf("%s — %s", summary, strings.TrimSpace(call.RiskReason))
   333→		}
   334→		tool.Summary = &summary
   335→	}
   336→	return tool
   337→}

   339→func todoItemsToMap(items []fdTodoItem) []map[string]interface{} {
   340→	result := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(items))
   341→	for _, item := range items {
   342→		result = append(result, map[string]interface{}{
   343→			"description": strings.TrimSpace(item.Description),
   344→			"status":      strings.TrimSpace(item.Status),
   345→		})
   346→	}
   347→	return result
   348→}
   349→
   350→func extractPathHints(input map[string]interface{}, workspaceRoot string) []string {
   351→	fields := []string{"path", "file_path", "filePath", "dir", "directory",
   352→		"workdir", "cwd", "target"}
   353→	var hints []string
   354→	if input == nil {
   355→		return hints
   356→	}
   357→	for _, field := range fields {
   358→		val, ok := input[field]
   359→		if !ok {
   360→			continue
   361→		}
   362→		switch v := val.(type) {
   363→		case string:
   364→			addPathHint(&hints, v, workspaceRoot)
   365→		case []interface{}:
   366→			for _, entry := range v {
   367→				if s, ok := entry.(string); ok {
   368→					addPathHint(&hints, s, workspaceRoot)
   369→				}
   370→			}
   371→		case json.Number:
   372→			addPathHint(&hints, v.String(), workspaceRoot)
   373→		}
   374→	}
   375→
   376→	// Extract paths from shell commands (redirect targets, file-creating commands)
   377→	// Check both "command" and "cmd" field names for shell tools
   378→	command, _ := input["command"].(string)
   379→	if command == "" {
   380→		command, _ = input["cmd"].(string)
   381→	}
   382→	if command != "" {
   383→		cwd, _ := input["workdir"].(string)
   384→		if cwd == "" {
   385→			cwd, _ = input["cwd"].(string)
   386→		}
   387→		if cwd == "" {
   388→			cwd = workspaceRoot
   389→		}
   390→		shellPaths := spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, cwd, workspaceRoot)
   391→		for _, sp := range shellPaths {
   392→			addPathHint(&hints, sp, workspaceRoot)
   393→		}
   394→	}
   395→
   396→	return hints
   397→}
   398→
   399→func addPathHint(hints *[]string, value string, workspaceRoot string) {
   400→	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
   401→	if value == "" {
   402→		return
   403→	}
   404→	normalized := spi.NormalizePath(value, workspaceRoot)
   405→	for _, existing := range *hints {
   406→		if existing == normalized {
   407→			return
   408→		}
   409→	}
   410→	*hints = append(*hints, normalized)
   411→}
   412→
